prompt: In 120 to 180 words, analyze why data leakage invalidates model evaluation in exactly five numbered points. Include one prevention measure and finish with a one-sentence conclusion.

turns.assistant_message:
Data leakage occurs when information from outside the training dataset is used to evaluate a model's performance, leading to inflated accuracy scores that do not reflect how well the model will perform on unseen data. This practice invalidates model evaluation in several ways:

1. Overfitting: Data leakage allows models to learn patterns that are present only in the training and validation datasets but not in real-world scenarios, resulting in overfitted models that perform poorly on new data.
